nodes.label: Avoid One-Minute Candles
nodes.rationale: One-minute candles are intentionally excluded in favor of exact executions with timestamp, price, size, and taker side.

nodes.label: Delayed Market Reaction
nodes.rationale: Completed MLB events can abruptly change game state and win probability while Kalshi may react incompletely or with a short delay, creating a reversion opportunity.

nodes.label: Guarded Real-Money Execution
nodes.rationale: Real execution requires explicit acknowledgements, balance checks, capital limits, durable risk tracking, and immediate-or-cancel orders to constrain account and execution risk.

nodes.label: Event-Agnostic Feature Contract
nodes.rationale: Event names are deliberately excluded so the model represents observable state transitions rather than event labels.

nodes.label: Hold-to-Settlement Policy
nodes.rationale: The deployed strategy disables early exits because historical overlays rely on trade prints while live execution observes order-book bids, and prior stop-loss results did not generalize cleanly.

nodes.label: Forward Validation Requirement
nodes.rationale: Deployment remains disabled because development holdouts are not pristine final tests, statistical uncertainty is high, and newly collected forward paper performance is still required.

nodes.label: Exclude Unused Context Features
nodes.rationale: Unused hitter-form and pitcher-context features are deliberately excluded from pitch-state output.
